disease.title: Crop Disease Detection
disease.subtitle: Take or upload a clear photo of the affected leaf, fruit, or stem for instant AI diagnosis
disease.tip1: Take a well-lit, close-up photo of the affected area.
disease.tip2: Ensure the leaf or symptoms are in sharp focus.
disease.tip3: Avoid blurred photos or photos taken in dark conditions.
disease.chooseCrop: Select crop or leave for auto-detect
disease.noHistory: No previous analyses found. Take your first photo above!

diseaseResult.title: AI Plant Health Assessment
diseaseResult.organicDesc: Eco-friendly, chemical-free methods to treat and restore crop health safely.
diseaseResult.treatmentDisclaimer: Chemical interventions must be used with extreme caution. Follow statutory product label guidelines, use protective gear (mask and gloves), and consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
diseaseResult.warningNote: Disclaimer: This is an AI-generated assessment based on photographic patterns and not a certified laboratory test. When in doubt, verify with local agricultural extension workers.
